browserEnabled.description: Enable the managed browser after installing its image and node seccomp profile.

browserSeccompProfile.description: Relative profile path beneath each node's kubelet seccomp directory.

browserRuntimeStorage.description: Storage request for each session's private browser PVC.

createNamespace.description: Create the sandbox namespace as part of the Helm release.

minFreeGb.description: Set the absolute free-space reserve to zero or a positive number of GB.

minFreePercent.description: Set the percentage free-space reserve above 0 and below 100.

failureThreshold.description: Positive number of failed startup probes allowed during database upgrades.

progressDeadlineSeconds.description: Positive rollout progress deadline in seconds. Allow more time than the startup probe budget.
